## Why this article

The project owner chose it from two candidates, on 2026-11-06. It played no part in any rule revision, so it checks the fourth revision and the fixes after it on new material. The revision carried no maintenance templates; the only `Fix` template comes from an inline dead-link marker in the references.

## Changes made

The article was captured with headless Google Chrome at 1024 CSS pixels wide, using a fresh browser profile with no sign-in or cookies. The full-page screenshot was cut into 10 pages of 1024 × 768 pixels, each starting 640 pixels below the previous one, so consecutive pages overlap. The last page ends at the article's cut-off and overlaps more. Pages were then scaled to 800 × 600 and saved as JPG, the same size as the `wiki-ml-zh` and `wiki-dt-zh` images. The capture covers the article from the top of the page to the start of the 参见 (See also) section. The see-also list, references, further reading, external links and footer were not captured. The text was not edited.
